armor.name: Rags
armor.shop_description: Technically clothing. I wouldn't call it armor, but it's free.

armor.description: +15 Defense, +5 Fortitude. A quilted coat: nothing fancy, and nothing missing either.
armor.name: Gambeson
armor.shop_description: A step up from bare skin. Modest, but modest beats dead.

armor.description: +30 Defense, -5 Fortitude. 30% of the damage a melee attacker deals to you is thrown straight back. Ranged and magical attacks sail past the spikes, and spells hurt a little more.
armor.name: Thornmail
armor.shop_description: Hit it and you'll wish you hadn't. Spells don't mind it nearly as much.

armor.description: +55 Defense, 0 Fortitude. Nothing sweeps you off a water tile -- but you move 1 tile less, and cliff falls deal 50% more damage.
armor.name: Fortress Plate
armor.shop_description: Stops almost anything short. Just don't trip near a cliff wearing it.

armor.description: +45 Defense, +35 Fortitude, and cliff falls deal no damage at all. Scaled by hand from something that shouldn't have died so easily.
armor.name: Dragonskin Plating
armor.shop_description: Don't ask where I got this. Just know it used to be attached to something much bigger than you.

armor.description: +10 Defense, +5 Fortitude, and every bodily hit that lands does 3 less damage (never below 1). A wall against goblin packs; a big single blow shrugs it off.
armor.name: Stonehide Mail
armor.shop_description: Small hits just stop mattering. Big ones, well. Let's not talk about the big ones.

armor.description: +25 Defense, +5 Fortitude. Built for bracing: Defend negates hits 8 points bigger than usual, and Defend and Taunt give back 10 more stamina. Nothing special unless you brace.
armor.name: Bastion Mail
armor.shop_description: Plant your feet and let them come. It's meant for exactly that.

armor.description: +5 Defense, +10 Fortitude, and a further +3 Defense for every 10% of your HP you're missing. Frail at full health; stubborn when you're not.
armor.name: Martyr's Mantle
armor.shop_description: It hardens with every wound. I'd rather not say how I know.

armor.description: +25 Defense, +10 Fortitude. Whatever hits you in melee catches fire. The heat wears you down: -10 max stamina.
armor.name: Cinder Mail
armor.shop_description: Still warm from the forge. Stays that way, somehow.

armor.description: +10 Defense, +26 Fortitude. Every hit you take stacks +10% damage dealt (up to 5 stacks, lasting 2 turns). Thin protection for a short temper.
armor.name: Bloodrage Hide
armor.shop_description: It remembers every blow. And returns them.

armor.description: +5 Defense, +30 Fortitude, +10% dodge, and a dodge makes your next attack a crit. Anything that does land hurts.
armor.name: Shadowweave
armor.shop_description: You won't even feel it. Neither will they -- until it's too late.

armor.description: +10 Defense, +28 Fortitude, +1 move tile, +2 Speed (it moves you up the turn order), and cliff falls deal no damage. Very thin.
armor.name: Windrunner's Jerkin
armor.shop_description: Light enough to forget you're wearing it. Fast enough to forget they were chasing you.

armor.description: +5 Defense, +25 Fortitude. The first magical hit of every battle is negated outright, and each magical hit that reaches you gives back 10 stamina. Almost no protection against steel.
armor.name: Spellward Robes
armor.shop_description: Stitched with wards by someone who clearly hated wizards.

armor.description: +20 Defense, +5 Fortitude. Allies within 2 tiles of you take 15% less damage.
armor.name: Warden's Aegis
armor.shop_description: Made for standing in front of other people.

foods.name: Dried Jerky
foods.shop_description: Tough, salty, and it keeps forever. Chew slowly.

foods.name: Smoked Sausage
foods.shop_description: Smoked over applewood. Best thing in the shop, and don't tell my wife.

foods.name: Roast Haunch
foods.shop_description: Fresh off the spit. A proper meal for someone who fights for a living.

foods.name: Fresh Bread
foods.shop_description: Still warm. Nothing fancy -- nothing wrong with it either.

foods.name: Meat Pie
foods.shop_description: Gravy, pastry, and a suspicious amount of pepper.

foods.name: Honey Cake
foods.shop_description: Sweet enough to get your arms swinging again.

brawler.description: A bare-knuckle fighter whose fists land twice as often as anyone expects. Fists and knuckle gloves reach one tile further in these hands.
brawler.name: Brawler

druid.description: A wild-woods healer who would rather mend than maim. Her spells restore and embolden her friends, and when she must move, she moves twice as far. Fragile, and worth protecting.
druid.name: Druid

guardian.description: A wall that walks. It only ever takes one step, hits twice as hard with a shield in hand, and shouts loud enough to rattle every enemy on the field.
guardian.name: Guardian

knight.description: A veteran who holds the line. Strongest with a greatsword, able to keep a shield up even behind a two-handed weapon, and far too proud to dodge.
knight.name: Knight

marksman.description: A sharpshooter who ignores range and cover, but will only ever fight with a bow. Arrows are cheap while the Marksman is around, and every other weapon costs more.
marksman.name: Marksman

necromancer.description: Pays for every spell in blood and grows a little stronger with each kill. Rots enemies from within and raises the fallen to fight again.
necromancer.name: Necromancer

rogue.description: Quick hands, quicker feet. Would rather lift an enemy's coin purse than its life, right up until the moment it decides otherwise. Always half in shadow: foes only notice the Rogue from close by, and its Stealth lasts longer, costs less and bites harder.
rogue.name: Rogue

shaman.description: Carries four talismans and shares their power with everyone nearby. Heals, cleanses, and keeps the whole party in tune.
shaman.name: Shaman

wolf.description: A traitor wolf that turned on its pack. The old magic that made wolves so savage still runs through it, so it fights harder than any hound should. It cannot level, wear gear or carry a weapon, and three faints will be its last.
wolf.name: Fickle Wolf

brawler.description: A bare-knuckle fighter whose fists land twice as often as anyone expects. Fists and knuckle gloves reach one tile further in these hands.
brawler.name: Brawler

druid.description: A wild-woods healer who would rather mend than maim. Her spells restore and embolden her friends, and when she must move, she moves twice as far. Fragile, and worth protecting.
druid.name: Druid

guardian.description: A wall that walks. It only ever takes one step, hits twice as hard with a shield in hand, and shouts loud enough to rattle every enemy on the field.
guardian.name: Guardian

knight.description: A veteran who holds the line. Strongest with a greatsword, able to keep a shield up even behind a two-handed weapon, and far too proud to dodge.
knight.name: Knight

marksman.description: A sharpshooter who ignores range and cover, but will only ever fight with a bow. Arrows are cheap while the Marksman is around, and every other weapon costs more.
marksman.name: Marksman

necromancer.description: Pays for every spell in blood and grows a little stronger with each kill. Rots enemies from within and raises the fallen to fight again.
necromancer.name: Necromancer

rogue.description: Quick hands, quicker feet. Would rather lift an enemy's coin purse than its life, right up until the moment it decides otherwise. Always half in shadow: foes only notice the Rogue from close by, and its Stealth lasts longer, costs less and bites harder.
rogue.name: Rogue

shaman.description: Carries four talismans and shares their power with everyone nearby. Heals, cleanses, and keeps the whole party in tune.
shaman.name: Shaman

wolf.description: A traitor wolf that turned on its pack. The old magic that made wolves so savage still runs through it, so it fights harder than any hound should. It cannot level, wear gear or carry a weapon, and three faints will be its last.
wolf.name: Fickle Wolf

potions.name: Health Potion
potions.shop_description: Drink up. Whatever's ailing you, this'll patch it.

potions.description: No healing, but empowers your next 3 turns of attacks with +25% damage.
potions.name: Attack Potion
potions.shop_description: Feel that? That's your arm asking permission to hit harder. Say yes.

potions.description: No healing, but adds +20 Defense and Fortitude for your next 3 turns.
potions.name: Resilience Potion
potions.shop_description: Won't stop a blade. Just stops it from mattering quite so much.

potions.description: No healing, but grants an extra tile of movement in battle for your next 3 turns.
potions.name: Energy Potion
potions.shop_description: Light on the feet, heavy on the results.

potions.description: No healing, but instantly refills your stamina to full.
potions.name: Stamina Potion
potions.shop_description: For when your arms give out before your enemies do.

potions.description: Heals 12 HP, and washes away poison, burning, bleeding, concussion, and blindness.
potions.name: Cleansing Potion
potions.shop_description: Poison, fire, whatever's clinging to you -- this scrubs it right off.

runes.description: Deal 50% more damage with every hit -- but violence like this always draws blood both ways. You take 15% of the damage you deal as recoil.
runes.name: Rune of Bloodlust
runes.shop_description: Power always costs something. This one just makes you pay it yourself.

runes.description: Heals you for 25% of all damage dealt -- but the ritual saps your strength. -20% damage dealt.
runes.name: Rune of the Leech
runes.shop_description: Trade a little bite for a lot of staying power. Fair deal, if you ask me.

runes.description: Specials cost 50% less stamina -- but channeling a storm through your weapon strains it badly. +15% chance to shatter with every swing.
runes.name: Rune of the Tempest
runes.shop_description: Swing all you like -- just don't come crying to me when it shatters.

runes.description: Every hit knocks the target back and ignores cover entirely -- but wielding this much force so precisely jars you just as hard. You take 10% of the damage you deal as recoil.
runes.name: Rune of Warding
runes.shop_description: Precision like that doesn't come free. Your own bones will remind you of that.

shield_brawler.description: Strapped to the forearm, built to punish -- a blocked hit only feeds the fire behind your next punch. Vengeance: a successful block empowers your very next attack for +50% damage (+75% with Knuckle Gloves). Passively adds +8 Defense. Fighting one-handed costs 10% of your own damage.
shield_brawler.name: Brawler's Buckler
shield_brawler.shop_description: Block with this and I'd pity whatever you hit next.

shield_buckler.description: A simple wooden shield -- steady, reliable, free. No special trick, just a full third of incoming hits bouncing right off. Pairs naturally with a Club: neither needs finesse.
shield_buckler.name: Wooden Buckler
shield_buckler.shop_description: Every adventurer's first shield. Simple, honest, doesn't cost you a thing.

shield_bulwark.description: A slab of iron built to eat a blow head-on and throw it right back -- a Hammer-wielder's whole philosophy, in shield form. Thorns: a successful block reflects 25% of the blocked hit back at the attacker (40% with a Hammer). Passively adds +15 Defense, and the best Defend threshold in the game on top. This much dead weight costs 15% of your own damage.
shield_bulwark.name: Iron Bulwark
shield_bulwark.shop_description: Heaviest one I stock. Hit it and you'll wish you hadn't.

shield_heavy.description: A slab too solid to move -- you can't be pushed while it's raised, water current included. A successful block shoves the attacker back a tile (two, with a Spear to brace against). Passively adds +10 Defense, and Defend alone shrugs off a bigger blow before falling back to halving it. Bracing this much steel behind you costs 10% of your own damage.
shield_heavy.name: Heavy Shield
shield_heavy.shop_description: Plant your feet behind this and nothing's moving you. Nothing at all.

shield_phantom.description: Barely more than a bracer -- less about blocking a blow than never being where it lands. A dodge earns you a single dodge-roll: back, left, or right, whichever way isn't blocked. Passively adds +5 Defense. Even this light a shield costs 8% of your own damage.
shield_phantom.name: Phantom Guard
shield_phantom.shop_description: Barely there, and that's the point. You won't even feel it -- until you need it.

items.description: 10% chance for any attack to set the target on fire (2% per hit on multi-hit moves). The fire deals (5 + your attack / 5) damage, then 70% of that again each turn after, rounded up, until it burns out.
items.name: Ember Charm

items.description: Traitor Wolves replace ordinary wolves 25% more often and are at least 30% likely to join when they fall. Adds a party slot only a Fickle Wolf can fill, and wolves stay 5 battles longer.
items.name: Wolf Fang

items.description: +100% damage while at or below 20% HP.
items.name: Berserker's Knot

items.description: -15% damage on every hit, but critical hits deal 300% damage and are 5% more likely to land.
items.name: Duelist's Coin

items.description: Whoever lands the first hit each battle -- you or an ally -- deals 50% more damage with it.
items.name: Whetstone Pendant

items.description: No limit on carried special arrows, but they cost 10% more.
items.name: Fletcher's Ring

items.description: Doubles what your current weapon's material does -- its damage, price, stamina and break-chance swings from plain steel are all doubled, and so is its passive. Steel itself becomes 1.2x damage at 0.8x price and 0.8x stamina.
items.name: Stone Amulet

items.description: The current can't sweep you off a water tile without asking first.
items.name: Turtle Shell

items.description: Your Taunt enrages the enemy past reason -- instead of converging on you, each one attacks whoever's nearest, even each other, picking randomly on an exact tie.
items.name: Wind Chime

items.description: Your allies gain +40 Defense and Fortitude.
items.name: Guardian Knot

items.description: 10% chance to survive a killing blow with 1 HP (once a battle).
items.name: Iron Will Band

items.description: Cliff falls deal no damage, and you can attack up a ledge or cliff drop with any weapon.
items.name: Cliffwalker's Bead

items.description: Whenever you cast a spell, a 20% chance you also strike the nearest enemy for your STR + half your MAG, with +30% damage if it is a mage.
items.name: Clapback

items.description: +1 Resilience and Fortitude for every 3 Magic you have.
items.name: Heavy Cloak

items.description: Regain 5% of your max mana at the end of each of your turns (the Necromancer heals 5% of her max HP).
items.name: Spell Bank

items.description: Spells cost 33% less mana (a Necromancer pays 33% less HP).
items.name: Dreamcatcher

items.description: Spells have +25% potency.
items.name: Snail Shell

items.description: 10% chance for a spell to cast twice: the second cast is free, and you choose its target again.
items.name: Lingering Echo

items.description: I CAST FIREBALL skips its charging turn.
items.name: Blazing Battery

items.description: Every summon is doubled: twice the skeletons, twice the spectres.
items.name: Loud Whistle

items.description: Regain 1 HP at the start of each of your battle turns, plus 1 more for every 20 max HP you have.
items.name: Moss Charm

items.description: Potions and food heal 25% more.
items.name: Healer's Knot

items.description: Heal 3 HP whenever an enemy falls.
items.name: Bloodstone

items.description: Regain 5 extra stamina each battle turn.
items.name: Second Wind Whistle

items.description: Every weapon special costs 5 less stamina.
items.name: Deep Lung Charm

items.description: Double chance for secondary effects to occur -- burning, bleeding, stuns, extra strikes, material passives and every other on-hit proc.
items.name: Lucky Clover

items.description: +10% coins from every source.
items.name: Merchant's Coin

items.description: -10% off every shop price.
items.name: Haggler's Tooth

items.description: +0.125 attack power and +0.1 damage reduction for every coin you're currently holding -- the more you hoard, the stronger you get.
items.name: Gilded Scarab

items.description: 20% chance for any landed hit to drop an extra coin (bosses excluded).
items.name: Tax Collector's Seal

items.description: +30% experience gained.
items.name: Scholar's Quill

items.description: +35% movement speed in the field.
items.name: Swift Feather

items.description: Every town and outskirts venue shows on your map immediately, instead of only once you've actually found it.
items.name: Pathfinder's Compass

items.description: Better odds at the Wishing Well and the horse races.
items.name: Gambler's Die

items.description: A wider bite window and rarer catches at the fishing hole.
items.name: Angler's Hook

items.description: Once per run, survive a killing blow with 1 HP.
items.name: Phoenix Ash

items.description: -50% max HP, but +75% damage on everything you deal.
items.name: Glass Cannon Charm

items.description: Heal 25% of all damage you deal -- but potions and food no longer work on you at all.
items.name: Vampire's Pact

items.description: Each hit you land without taking damage first adds +8% damage, uncapped -- but the instant you're hit, the chain breaks and stuns you.
items.name: Momentum Chain

items.description: Every melee attack strikes twice, but all damage (from any source) is cut to 40%.
items.name: Whirlwind Charm

items.description: Pick any 3 specials you've learned at the Dojo (from any weapon) as your loadout, regardless of what you're holding -- but every special costs 30% more stamina.
items.name: Weapon Whisperer

items.description: Every hit deals somewhere between 50% and 160% of its normal damage, rerolled each time.
items.name: Chaos Shard

items.description: Every attack instantly kills a regular enemy (bosses unaffected) -- but your HP is permanently locked at 1, no matter what else you wear.
items.name: Last Stand Idol

items.description: Each hit you land on anything stacks Bloodlust: +5% damage and +7.5% move speed per stack. But 3 turns with no hit landed by anyone crashes it, halving all your stats.
items.name: Bloodmoon Fang

items.description: You can only Move on every other turn, but your defense is multiplied by 250%.
items.name: Ironclad Ward

items.description: A burning enemy that dies explodes into 3x its fire damage, hurting and igniting everything nearby -- allies and you included.
items.name: Wildfire Core

adrenaline.description: +8% extra damage DEALT per level while below 30% HP.
adrenaline.name: Adrenaline

aegis_transcendence.description: Walk into a shop with a full stamina bar and it is 10% cheaper, for every full 100 Stamina you carry.
aegis_transcendence.name: Aegis & Transcendence

agility.description: Putting a level-up into Agility grants +10 more.
agility.name: Endurance Training

battle_hardened.description: Puts the Knight within reach: find him in the Ruined Settlement and he joins your party. Unlocks the party system, and dismissing party members for a while.
battle_hardened.name: Friends in High Places

battle_medic.description: Using a healing item in battle deals 5 damage to every enemy.
battle_medic.name: Battle Medic

beastmaster.description: Every run starts with a Traitor Wolf already in your pack, loyal for 25 battles.
beastmaster.name: Man's Best Friend

berserker_edge.description: +1% chance per level for ANY attack, with any weapon, to strike twice -- stacks with a weapon's own double-hit passive.
berserker_edge.name: Pure Spite

black_market.description: Shop rerolls cost 20% less per level.
black_market.name: Black Market

block_master.description: +10% chance per level to completely negate a hit while Defending.
block_master.name: Parry Master

continual_growth.description: Putting a level-up into Might grants +1 more.
continual_growth.name: Continual Growth

continual_learning.description: Unlocks Intelligence, which grows by +1 every level-up. (Intelligence is not a stat in the game yet, so this does nothing until it is.)
continual_learning.name: Continual Learning

deep_well.description: +20 max mana for every caster in your party (a Necromancer's mana is her HP: 5 mana is 1 HP).
deep_well.name: Deep Well

dexterity_unlock.description: Unlocks Dexterity as a level-up choice -- 0.5% chance per point owned for an attack to critically strike (double damage, ignores cover), capped at 10%.
dexterity_unlock.name: Deft Fingers

field_surgeon.description: Healing potions in the shop cost 1% less per level.
field_surgeon.name: Herbalist

fletcher.description: Special arrows cost 5% less per level, and you can hold 3 more of each per level.
fletcher.name: Fletcher

golden_touch.description: Every shop visit offers one extra weapon, guaranteed Fine quality or better.
golden_touch.name: Merchant's Favour

haggling.description: +5% bonus coins per level from every source.
haggling.name: Magpie

herbalism.description: +5% bonus healing per level from every healing item.
herbalism.name: Field Surgeon

heroic_destiny.description: You start every run with a wooden club and a wooden shield.
heroic_destiny.name: Heroic Destiny

intimidation.description: Putting a level-up into Intimidation grants +1 more (cheaper shops sooner).
intimidation.name: Presence

last_stand.description: +1% damage reduction per level for every 10% of your HP you're missing.
last_stand.name: Last Stand

legacy.description: The foundation of all mortal power. Unlocks the first upgrade of every branch.
legacy.name: Legacy

light_metal.description: Weapons ask for half the Might to wield (rounded up).
light_metal.name: Light Metal

luck.description: Improves shop weapon-tier odds toward Fine, Masterwork, and Legendary.
luck.name: Good Fortune

momentum.description: +8% damage per level for the rest of the battle, per enemy you defeat this battle -- stacks, resets each fight.
momentum.name: Momentum

otherworldly_power.description: Allows the wizards to breach the veil. Unlocks the true ending. Needs every other upgrade, fully bought.
otherworldly_power.name: Otherworldly Power

pack_bond.description: Your wolves stay 4 battles longer per level before they leave your pack.
pack_bond.name: Pack Bond

painful_memories.description: Rage grows by +1 every level-up. (Rage is not a stat in the game yet, so this does nothing until it is.)
painful_memories.name: Painful Memories

potions.description: +1 healing item at the start of every run, per level.
potions.name: Preparations

prodigy.description: The level-up bonus-stat choice grants +2 instead of +1.
prodigy.name: Scholar

rage.description: +10% bonus damage per level while Berserk is active (triggered by killing an enemy mid-battle).
rage.name: RAGE

reflexes_unlock.description: Unlocks Reflexes as a level-up choice -- 0.5% chance per point owned to fully dodge an incoming hit, capped at 15%.
reflexes_unlock.name: Sharp Mind

release_grudge.description: Allows the recruitment of magical party members (the Druid, the Necromancer, the Shaman) and unlocks the Magic stat for every party member (not you), who also gain +1 Magic every level-up.
release_grudge.name: Release Grudge

resilience_unlock.description: Unlocks Resilience as a level-up choice -- +1 Defense per point owned, pooled with your armour. Defense has diminishing returns and never passes 80% reduction.
resilience_unlock.name: Leather Skin

riposte.description: +2% chance per level, when Reflexes fully dodges a hit, to immediately counter-attack whoever swung at you for 50% damage.
riposte.name: Riposte

second_breath.description: +5 Stamina automatically at the start of every one of your turns, per level.
second_breath.name: Full Breath

silver_muscles.description: Every weapon special costs 5 less stamina, with any weapon you equip.
silver_muscles.name: Silver Muscles

smart_savage.description: Unlocks Fortitude as a level-up choice, and it grows by +1 every level-up. Fortitude has diminishing returns and never passes 80% reduction of MAGICAL harm.
smart_savage.name: Smart Savage

strength.description: Putting a level-up into Strength grants +1 more.
strength.name: Physical Training

take_a_breather.description: Defending (the way you skip a turn) heals you for 1/16 of your max HP.
take_a_breather.name: Take a Breather

unbreakable_guard.description: Your equipped shield stays active even with a two-handed weapon equipped. Needs every other Sustain upgrade, fully bought.
unbreakable_guard.name: Unbreakable Guard

vampiric_grit.description: +5% lifesteal on every hit, with any weapon.
vampiric_grit.name: Bloodlust

vigor.description: Putting a level-up into Vigor grants +2 more.
vigor.name: Dense Muscles

war_profiteer.description: Every enemy you defeat in a run makes the shops 0.2% cheaper, for the rest of that run.
war_profiteer.name: War Profiteer

windfall.description: +10% chance per level for a defeated enemy to drop a bonus 1-3 gold.
windfall.name: Keen Eye

worldwalker.description: The strength you earned conquering the Nothingness -- always-on +15% max HP and +10% damage. Unlocked only after beating the game once.
worldwalker.name: Worldwalker

difficulties.description: Enemies have 75% HP and deal 75% damage. Gentler runs, less Essence earned.
difficulties.name: Baby Mode

difficulties.description: Enemies at standard HP and damage. The intended experience.
difficulties.name: Normal Mode

difficulties.description: Enemies have 175% HP and deal 175% damage. A real fight, more Essence earned.
difficulties.name: Hard Mode

difficulties.description: Enemies have 300% HP and deal 300% damage. Brutal -- but Essence earned triples too.
difficulties.name: Apocalyptic

bomb.description: 20 flat damage to every unit in a 3x3 area centered on the target -- allies and you included, if you're standing in the blast.
bomb.name: Bomb Arrow
bomb.shop_description: One arrow, whole crowd. Mind the blast radius, that's all I'll say.

flame.description: A small flat hit plus half your damage stat, then sets the target Burning: loses HP and deals 25% less damage every turn until it steps into water.
flame.name: Flame Arrow
flame.shop_description: Light 'em up and watch 'em squirm. Works even better near a nice dry field.

freeze.description: 5 flat damage. Freezes the target for 2-4 turns -- it can't act, and takes 20% more damage while frozen.
freeze.name: Freeze Arrow
freeze.shop_description: Nothing personal. Just a little chill to slow 'em down.

bases.description: Great reach, hits diagonally, fast, light damage.
bases.name: Spear
bases.shop_description: Reach without the risk -- keep 'em at arm's length and you'll never get your hands dirty.

specials.description: 140% damage that ignores rock cover and pierces through to a second enemy standing one tile beyond the first.
specials.name: Piercing Thrust

specials.description: 5-10 rapid jabs at 18% damage each -- the odds of extra hits rise with your Fortune.
specials.name: Wombo Combo

specials.description: 30%% chance to instantly kill a regular enemy (5%% vs. a boss). On a miss, your spear flies to a random tile and you can't Fight until you reach it.
specials.name: Target Practice

bases.description: Wide horizontal slash, heavy damage, slow.
bases.name: Greatsword
bases.shop_description: Slow to swing, but when it lands, they stay landed.

specials.description: 2-5 spinning passes, each dealing 40% damage to every enemy in range.
specials.name: Whirlwind Strike

specials.description: 70% damage, with an 80% chance to sweep the target's legs out, halving its movement for the rest of the battle.
specials.name: Low Sweep

specials.description: 150% damage to everyone standing in the 3 tiles directly toward your target. Refused outright if cover blocks the way.
specials.name: Wide Cleave

bases.name: Hammer
bases.shop_description: Not subtle. Not fast. Devastating? Absolutely.

specials.description: 80% damage, and permanently shatters the target's armor.
specials.name: Crushing Collision

specials.description: 130% damage -- 200% if the target is armored.
specials.name: Maracas

specials.description: 110% damage. Leaves the target Concussed: a 33% chance to hit itself instead of you for the next few turns.
specials.name: BONK

bases.description: Slow sweeping cleave, huge damage, 20% instant kill.
bases.name: Battle Axe
bases.shop_description: One in five swings, something doesn't get back up. The other four, it wishes it hadn't.

specials.description: 230% damage -- but the follow-through leaves you unable to act next turn.
specials.name: Devastating Slash

specials.description: Instantly kills an armorless enemy. Deals no damage at all against an armored one.
specials.name: Execution

specials.description: 40% damage, and the target loses its next turn.
specials.name: Oldest Trick in the Book

bases.description: Very fast, light damage, favors relentless pressure.
bases.name: Dagger
bases.shop_description: Quick, quiet, and cheap. My personal favorite, for... reasons.

specials.description: 8-13 lightning-fast slices at 10% damage each.
specials.name: Slicing Flurry

specials.description: Full damage, with an independent 50% chance to cause Bleeding and a separate 50% chance to land as a guaranteed crit.
specials.name: Bleeding Cut

specials.description: 300% damage -- but if it kills the target, you're left disarmed, weapon flung to a random tile.
specials.name: Knife Throw

bases.description: Long reach, light damage, attacks from range 2 in battle. A regular attack costs 10 stamina, a Heavy Attack 20.
bases.name: Bow
bases.shop_description: Keep your distance and let them do all the walking.

bases.description: 10% chance for any attack to land twice in a flurry of jabs. Very close range.
bases.name: Knuckle Gloves
bases.shop_description: No blade required. Just knuckle and a grudge.

specials.description: Hits your target twice at 75% damage each -- or, if a second enemy is in range, splits between both at 70% each instead.
specials.name: The 'Ol One-Two

specials.description: 65% damage, and knocks the target's weapon loose -- it can't attack until it reaches the tile it lands on.
specials.name: Wrist Strike

specials.description: 230% damage, hurling the target to the tile directly behind you.
specials.name: Clotheslined

bases.description: Built to tear through the hardest material -- +20% damage against armored enemies, with any attack.
bases.name: Hand Picks
bases.shop_description: Miners swear by 'em. Turns out they work just as well on skulls.

specials.description: Costs your turn. For the rest of the battle, your attacks deal 80% damage but every regular or heavy attack has a 1-in-3 chance to strike twice.
specials.name: Pichaku

specials.description: Jump onto any enemy on the grid, ignoring terrain entirely. 250% damage, knocking them back a tile as you land -- but a 20% chance to miss entirely, taking 20% of your own max HP instead.
specials.name: DIAMONDS

specials.description: 4-7 whirling pickaxe strikes at 20% damage each.
specials.name: Minernado

club.name: Club
club.shop_description: Everyone starts somewhere. Won't win you any medals, but it won't cost you a copper either.

specials.description: 120% damage that ignores rock cover, and permanently slows the target by 1 tile of movement (down to a minimum of 1).
specials.name: Thy Kneecaps are Mine

specials.description: 60% damage, and heals you for ~10% of your max HP.
specials.name: Second Wind

specials.description: 130% damage, plus 50% more against a target still at full HP.
specials.name: Heavy Swing

battle_axe.description: Carried by hands that never hesitated. A plain swing carries a real chance the job ends right there.
battle_axe.name: The Executioner's Axe

bow.description: Every arrow finds exactly where it's aimed, stone and armor be damned, and there's nowhere on the whole field left to hide -- though the further out it flies, the more it loses on the way.
bow.name: Aimbot

dagger.description: It's unknown where it came from. It has a pristine blade, almost that of a mirror, though it's marred by many layers of the same person's blood.
dagger.name: The Implement

greatsword.description: Somehow, impossibly, longer than it looks -- everything you swing at was already within reach before you started swinging, and it hits harder the further out it goes.
greatsword.name: The Looongblade

hammer.description: Said to been abandoned by a certain norse god for another hammer. Sure, it has a great personality, but it's hard to tell when it's constantly complaining about being dumped -- and about that stagger nobody seems to walk off.
hammer.name: Second Best

hand_picks.description: Once wielded by an unkillable prisoner, these were once a makeshift weapon. However, in the right hands...
hand_picks.name: Frying Pans

knuckle_gloves.description: Though they haven't seen much combat, these really pack a punch. They seem to be made of fake gold.
knuckle_gloves.name: Grunkle Gloves

spear.description: A giant's dinner is still clinging to the wood. ...Ew?
spear.name: The Great Toothpicke

staff.description: Whoever carries it learns the old words twice as fast.
staff.name: Moonstick
